Is this your first company? If so, what are the challenges you've faced so far you didn't expect? What problem are you trying to solve now?

Inzopa is my first company in Silicon Valley. I've run several successful and not so successful business back in Mumbai.

We have faced several challenges related to identifying product market fit. It's never obvious when you launch, in majority of the cases there will be a gap between what a founding team thinks the market needs versus what the market really ends up using.

Everyday billions of new pages of content get published on the web. It is very difficult for even fortune 50 companies to figure out relevant content that will help them get discovered by potential customers through online search, which in return will drive high leads through the website. We learnt from our data and customers to evolve into a fully automated technology platform to create highly relevant content. We are used by several hundred financial institutions to get discovered through Inzopa for their expertise in organic search.
